ns2:course.label: Soviet & Post-Sov Foreign Pol
ns2:course.description: Surveys Soviet and Post-Soviet foreign policy from 1917 to the present, with emphasis upon the forces shaping this policy; special attention to the interplay of ideology and national interest in policy formulation. Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 283, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: PS 280 or PS 283, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Political Science major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
